articles.title: Proposed Grid 2.0 protocol would enable 'connect and manage' for both load and generation
articles.description: Senior staff at AES Corporation and Fluence have published a protocol designed as a universal means to scale flexible interconnection of both new loads and new generators. They have launched a standards development process modeled after the process that brought forth the internet.
